title: CLARKSONS HELLAS - SnP WEEKLY
summary:
Main
S&P activity has remained on an overall strong course as we have entered September month. Freight rates maintain very high numbers across both dry and wet spaces, which continue to underpin asset prices and S&P appetite, albeit the uncertainty associated with the ongoing geopolitical disturbances in the Black Sea and the Middle East. More specifically, this Friday, Capesize spot rates reached $58,000 per day, representing new multi-year highs, namely since December 2023 when they briefly reached $60,000.
